Design and Architecture

Your cloud must function stably from the very first minute. It should grow with your company in the long term and adapt effortlessly to new requirements. socket lays the foundation for a secure, scalable cloud architecture. This naturally runs on the latest technology.

Setup and Operation

Open Source, specialized software, and various providers: When searching for the right soft- and hardware, do you have the agony of choice rather than the choice itself? We have been working with all common systems for many years. That’s why we can honestly tell you which solution optimally suits your requirements – and which does not. For “I forgot something” questions, we are only a phone call away at any time.

Consulting

You simply don’t have time to deal with “OpenStack” and “Ceph”? We understand that – after all, you want to be able to fully concentrate on your company. In the meantime, we’ve got your back when it comes to cloud architecture. Our team advises you on suitable solutions. We discuss exactly the things that matter. No more and no less. In this way, we jointly develop high-quality and fluid concepts that can do what they are supposed to do.

Workshops

Do you want to look behind the scenes of your cloud solution yourself? We are happy to hear that! Our qualified employees put together individual workshops upon request, in which we discuss all the topics you want to learn more about. Theoretical concepts and explanations are followed by a practical part where you can experiment directly with what you have learned.
